
# Jothi Heart & Skin Clinic

Jothi Heart & Skin Clinic is a dual-specialty medical clinic in Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu, India.

We specialize in:

- Cardiology Consultation

- Echocardiogram (ECHO)
- TMT Stress Test

Jothi Heart & Skin Clinic is a medical clinic in Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu, India, providing cardiology, dermatology, aesthetics, and hair-related healthcare services.

About

Jothi Heart & Skin Clinic provides medical consultation and diagnostic, dermatological, aesthetic, and hair treatment services.

Information published on the website is intended for general educational and informational purposes.

Website content does not replace consultation, diagnosis, or treatment from a qualified medical professional.

Treatment suitability, expected results, risks, number of sessions, and treatment plans may vary depending on the individual patient's medical condition and clinical assessment.

Patients should consult an appropriately qualified healthcare professional for personalised medical advice.

The website does not provide emergency medical services or real-time emergency medical assistance.

In a medical emergency, patients should contact the appropriate emergency medical service or visit the nearest emergency department.
